summary.text: Brian Nadeau is the incumbent Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 4, in the November 3, 2026 general election. He has represented the district since December 2024, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Nadeau served in the U.S. Army.
His career experience includes working as a mechanic, welder, and fabricator.
